target: the REAL full application at http://localhost:8080 (web/nginx proxy -> api -> PostgreSQL16+pgvector -> single processing child)
objective: Measure the complete resume-to-matches journey and concurrent upload bursts to inform a simple, justified AWS architecture. No optimisation or infrastructure changes.

environment.backend_code_vs_running_image: VERIFIED IDENTICAL: sha256 over all app/**/*.py in container == on-disk src/backend; key routes byte-identical. Running images were built 2026-09-23; the last src/ commit (a9d2c3b, 2026-09-23) is included. HEAD adds only docs since.
environment.runtime: api: FastAPI 0.141.1 / uvicorn 0.53.0 / Python 3.11.16, single worker, single processing slot (ProcessingService, one spawned child). APP_ENV=development.
environment.host: macOS 26.5.2 (25F84), arm64, 10 logical CPUs, 32 GiB RAM
environment.load_driver: evidence/baseline-2026-09-25-journey/journey_load.py — pure Python 3.14.6 stdlib on host; nothing installed; tests/load/* untouched.

method.journey: prepare (multipart PDF) -> PUT /api/resume (save: privacy re-check + chunk + MiniLM embed + persist, idempotent by Idempotency-Key) -> GET /api/resume (reload) -> GET /api/matches
method.correctness: Not HTTP-200-alone. Per step: response-schema/shape validation; save requires changed=true and result_revision=expected+1; reload requires revision match, has_matchable_resume=true, and canonical content-hash equality vs saved content (round-trip); matches requires total>0 with a non-empty closest_passage. Assertion failures recorded separately from HTTP/transport errors. DB check (separate from HTTP) confirmed persisted 384-dim non-null embeddings.
method.retry_runner_policy: Distinct from the frontend. Retryable transient codes (PROCESSING_BUSY, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, PROCESSING_TIMEOUT, SAVE_IN_PROGRESS, MODEL_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE) retried honouring Retry-After if present else full-jitter exponential backoff (base 0.25s, x2, cap 3s), max 8 attempts / 60 s elapsed. Saves retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key (idempotent: busy creates no op row; SAVE_IN_PROGRESS/timeout replay). REVIEW_REQUIRED handled as a confirmation (resubmit returned cleaned draft under a NEW key), not a blind retry. Deterministic validation errors never retried. Initial rejection recorded separately from eventual completion.
scenarios: synchronised burst of 5 distinct clients, each one journey, browsing concurrently (x3)
synchronised burst of 10 distinct clients, browsing concurrently (x3)
method.isolation: Fresh pool of 60 synthetic accounts per scenario (google_sub prefix loadtest-journey-2026-09-25:); deleted on exit incl. failure. Tokens written OUTSIDE the repo and never printed or stored in evidence. The pre-existing untracked evidence/baseline-2026-09-25-fullapp/sessions.json was neither reused nor committed.
method.caches: WARM: containers up ~2 days, embedding child resident, catalogue tiny and page-cached; DB ~9 MB. Warm-up journeys (3 sequential, 2 per burst) discarded before measured rounds.
excluded_by_http_automation: human editing and privacy-review reading time
Google OAuth sign-in (synthetic sessions injected directly)

results: See analysis.json for full metrics; compact summary in baseline-2026-09-25-journey.md. Headlines: sequential whole-journey p50 181 ms / p95 477 ms / max 501 ms, 45/45 completed, ~4.6 journeys/s single-threaded, 0 retries. burst5 15/15 eventual success but only 3/15 first-attempt, 30 busy-503 + 30 retries, whole-journey p50 6.2 s / p95 12.3 s. burst10 24/30 eventual (6 gave up at prepare after exhausting retries; all were app 503 PROCESSING_BUSY, not errors or assertion failures), 132 busy-503 + 126 retries, whole-journey p50 10.8 s / p95 21.4 s. Concurrent browse: 100% success (0/6172 failures across bursts), p50 ~9 ms / p95 ~18 ms. No PROCESSING_TIMEOUTs, no unexpected errors, no assertion failures anywhere.
data_integrity: Content-level md5 digests of all non-synthetic tables (incl. resume_chunks.embedding vectors) IDENTICAL before and after the run. Existing data content unchanged, not merely row counts.
